about.title: About ClipWorld

language.title: Language
language.pseudoHint: Shows text that isn't translatable yet, or that gets cut off
language.missingFallback: Anything a language doesn't have yet is shown in English.

settings.title: Settings
settings.previewVolumeHint: How loud the preview plays. Exported videos are not affected.
settings.autoImportHint: When on, using a preset imports the files it needs without asking first.
settings.layoutHint: Puts every window back where it started.
settings.clipColorsHint: The color of each kind of clip on the timeline. Pick any color: on light colors, waveforms and subtitle blocks are drawn dark so they stay easy to see.

errors.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg was not found. Run "npm run fetch-ffmpeg" or set its location in settings.
errors.noContent: {{name}} has no video, audio or image content
errors.onlyVideoConverts: Only video files can be converted
errors.alreadyMp4: This file is already an MP4

media.emptyHint: Drop files here or use Import. A video's audio tracks are extracted automatically.
media.mp4Tip: MP4 files are recommended for the smoothest video.
media.dragHint: Drag to the timeline, or double-click to add at the playhead
media.optimizingHint: Building a seek-friendly preview copy in the background, starting where you are working. Playback and export use the original meanwhile.
media.convertHint:
Save an MP4 copy next to the original and use it in this project. MP4 plays most smoothly in the preview.
Streams are copied without re-encoding when possible. {{name}} itself is not changed.
media.fastSeekHint: Having trouble with slow or choppy seeking in this video? This builds a 720p preview copy in the background, starting where you are working, so jumping around the timeline is quick. It uses roughly half a gigabyte per hour of video. Exports always use the original file.
media.fastSeekStopHint: Stop building the fast-seek preview copy. Finished parts are kept, so turning it back on resumes.
media.fastSeekOffHint: Stop using the fast-seek preview copy. It stays on disk, so turning it back on is instant.
media.delete: Delete from project (removes its clips from the timeline)
media.trackHint: Drag to the timeline to use this audio track on its own

preview.volumeHint: Preview volume — does not affect the export

audio.empty: Select a video on the timeline to see and mix its audio tracks.
audio.none: The selected clip has no audio tracks.

metadata.applyHint: Changes apply immediately to the preview and to the export. Timeline length: {{length}}.
metadata.name: Name

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Click a shortcut, then press the new key combination. Escape cancels.
shortcuts.conflict: {{keys}} was assigned to “{{action}}”, which now has no shortcut.

export.title: Export
export.metadataHint: Resolution and frame rate are set in the Metadata window.

subtitles.emptyHint: Type them in here, or import a subtitle file. Each track can be exported as a subtitle file, and added to the timeline to put it in the video.
subtitles.deleteTrack: Delete this subtitle track (and its clips on the timeline)
subtitles.toTimelineHint: Put this track on the timeline as a clip. That puts the subtitles into the exported video, and lets you move, stretch, transform and add effects to them.
subtitles.onTimelineHint: This track is in the video. Select its clip on the timeline to move it or add effects.
subtitles.searching: Looking for subtitle tracks in your videos…
subtitles.noStreams: None of the project's videos contain subtitle tracks.
subtitles.pictureBased: Picture-based subtitles (DVD/Blu-ray) cannot be turned into text
subtitles.timingTimeline: Match the video (where the clip sits on the timeline)
subtitles.addHint: Add a subtitle at the playhead ({{keys}})
subtitles.setStartHint: Set the selected subtitle's start to the playhead ({{keys}})
subtitles.setEndHint: Set the selected subtitle's end to the playhead ({{keys}})
subtitles.emptyList: No subtitles yet. Move the playhead to where someone speaks and press {{keys}} or {{add}}.

tools.empty: Select a clip on the timeline to zoom, transform or add filters and effects.

text.title: Text
text.empty: Add a text clip at the playhead, or select one on the timeline to edit it.

speed.title: Speed
speed.keepPitch: Keep audio pitch when speed changes
speed.hint: Dragging a clip's edge on the timeline changes its speed to fit the new length.

zoom.title: Zoom on video
zoom.enable: Zoom into the clip over its length

mask.title: Mask
mask.imageHint: Show and hide parts of the clip with an image
mask.differenceHint: Hide what matches the video underneath or a clean background (clone shots)
mask.empty: Hide parts of this clip so what's underneath shows through. Masks apply before filters and effects.

hints.colorMask: Makes one colour see-through. Raise Tolerance to include similar shades.
hints.imageMask: White areas of the image show the clip and black areas hide it (grey is in between). The image is stretched over the clip.
hints.differenceMask: Hides the parts of this clip that match the reference. For a clone shot, put two takes from the same fixed camera on top of each other and compare the top one with a clean background: a frame with nobody in shot.

image.unusable: That file can't be used here: choose a still image

imageOrVideo.unusable: That file can't be used here: choose a still image or a video

effects.title: Filters & effects
effects.empty: No effects yet. Add as many as you like — they apply top to bottom.

properties.empty: Select a clip on the timeline to see and change its properties.
properties.nothing: This kind of clip has no speed or loop settings. Use the Tools window to style it.
properties.pitchHint: Pitch is in semitones: +12 is an octave higher. It is the Pitch shift effect on the clip's sound.
properties.loopHint: Plays part of the file over and over. You can also hold Ctrl and drag a clip's edge on the timeline to loop it.
properties.loopInfo: The loop is {{length}} s long, and the file is {{file}} long. Loop points are times in the file.
properties.introHint: Start from the beginning of the file and play up to the loop.
properties.outroHint: After the last loop, carry on past the loop end to the end of the file.
properties.partialWarning: The loop count isn't a whole number, so the last loop stops part way and crossfades into the outro. That may not sound right, because the sound changes mid-phrase. For a seamless join, use a whole number of loops.
properties.noRoom: There isn't room on the track for that. Move or shorten the next clip first.

presets.selectHint: Select clips on the timeline to save them as a preset.
presets.empty: No presets yet. Saved presets can be used in any project.
presets.applyHint: Add this preset to the timeline at the playhead
presets.partly_one: Added “{{name}}” without the clips of {{count}} file that could not be imported
presets.partly_other: Added “{{name}}” without the clips of {{count}} files that could not be imported
presets.autoImport: Auto import media when using presets
presets.importQuestion: The following files need to be imported to use this preset, would you like to import them now?
presets.missingHint_one: {{count}} file is no longer where it was saved from. It will be added as missing media: use Locate in the Media window to find it.
presets.missingHint_other: {{count}} files are no longer where they were saved from. They will be added as missing media: use Locate in the Media window to find them.

easeEditor.title: Easing
easeEditor.open: Change how this animation speeds up and slows down
easeEditor.hint: Drag the points and handles. Double-click to add a point; right-click it or press Delete to remove it. Alt+drag a handle to move it on its own.
easeEditor.builtInHint: Drag any point to start editing a copy of it.
